summary: Backend-only testing for video playback fallback system (Netflix/YouTube-style). All 13 tests passed. The episode API correctly returns multi-quality MP4 fallback URLs and all CDN URLs are accessible with CORS enabled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Video fallback system fully tested. The GET /api/episodes/{id} endpoint returns all video URL formats: video_url (HLS), hls_url, mp4_url (720p default), mp4_urls (720p/480p/360p dict), and embed_url. All MP4 CDN URLs return HTTP 200 with access-control-allow-origin: * (CORS enabled for all origins). Frontend fallback logic can be tested visually by simulating HLS failures.
